mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(payment_amount), 0) FROM payment WHERE payment_status = 'COMPLETED' AND approved_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND approved_at < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)
SELECT NVL(SUM(total_refund_amount), 0) FROM refund WHERE refund_status = 'COMPLETED' AND completed_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND completed_at < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND created_at < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND created_at < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1
SELECT NVL(SUM(payment_amount), 0) FROM payment WHERE payment_status = 'COMPLETED' AND approved_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND approved_at < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE created_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND created_at < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_no) FROM product_option WHERE stock <= 5 AND use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refund WHERE refund_status = 'REQUESTED'

SELECT TO_CHAR(order_date, 'MM-DD') AS label, NVL(sales, 0) AS sales FROM ( SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) - LEVEL + 1 AS order_date FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TRUNC(p.approved_at) AS approved_date, NVL(SUM(p.payment_amount), 0) AS sales FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_status = 'COMPLETED' AND p.approved_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 6 AND p.approved_at < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 GROUP BY TRUNC(p.approved_at) ) s ON d.order_date = s.approved_date ORDER BY d.order_date

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC, p.product_no DESC ) AS rank, p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS productName, SUM(oi.quantity) AS totalSoldQuantity FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_no = o.order_no JOIN product_option po ON oi.product_option_no = po.product_option_no JOIN product p ON po.product_no = p.product_no WHERE o.order_status != 'CANCELED' GROUP BY p.product_no, p.name ) WHERE rank <= 5
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT o.order_no, o.orderer_name, o.total_price, o.order_status, o.created_at FROM orders o ORDER BY o.created_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, po.product_option_no AS productOptionNo, po.color AS color, po.option_Size AS optionSize, po.stock AS stock FROM product_option po JOIN product p ON po.product_no = p.product_no WHERE po.stock <= 5 AND po.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY po.stock ASC, p.product_no DESC
